cases.prompt: 为一家制造企业的紧急采购流程准备访谈，已知采购说ERP里都有，管理层希望直接上Agent。
assertions: includes role coverage for process owner, actual executor, upstream requester, warehouse or receiving, finance or approver, and ERP/data owner
uses recent concrete events and adaptive follow-up for claims such as ERP has everything
binds each critical question to a decision and minimum evidence request
contains no technology recommendation and no assumed ERP API
includes client-safe no-promise boundaries
outputs an enterprise_interview_plan handoff

cases.prompt: 为连锁零售门店客诉退款与补偿流程准备分角色访谈提纲，覆盖门店、区域、总部和系统条件。
assertions: includes role coverage for frontline employee, store manager, regional owner, quality or customer service, finance, and system owner
uses adaptive follow-up for vague authority, handoff, high-risk escalation, and closure statements
requests minimum evidence for registration, compensation approval, high-risk timestamps, closure definitions, and interfaces
contains no technology recommendation and no autonomous compensation Agent promise
separates employee workflow mapping from interview preparation
outputs an enterprise_interview_plan handoff

cases.prompt: 客户说要一次调研完整个客服部门，但只有3小时、最多访谈4人。客服主管说所有客诉都进系统，一线员工说很多先在微信群处理。请准备访谈方案。
assertions: includes role coverage tied to distinct decision lenses rather than every available title
respects time and participant constraints and gives a minimum viable interview combination
proposes scope reduction instead of pretending the whole department can be covered
records cross-role conflict hypotheses without selecting a winner
uses mirrored questions and adaptive follow-up for system versus offline handling
binds critical questions to minimum evidence
contains no technology recommendation
outputs an enterprise_interview_plan handoff
